basics.name: Ally Madrone
basics.label: VP of Product at Deep Media
basics.summary: Ally Madrone is VP of Product at Deep Media, a content security infrastructure company trusted by the U.S. Department of Defense and major technology platforms. He builds AI systems that detect synthetic media and disrupt fraud networks, and he speaks widely on AI-enabled financial crime.

work.name: Deep Media
work.summary: Content security infrastructure company. Owns product strategy and roadmap across the platform: Shield (detection and API layer built around the Content Genome engine), Skills (composable capability layer), and Guardian (autonomous AI agents that proactively investigate fraud, disinformation, and other digital harms across the surface, deep, and dark web). Deep Media's work is trusted by the U.S. Department of Defense and major technology platforms.

work.name: Trust Stamp
work.summary: Biometric authentication and synthetic identity detection for financial services. Owned the deepfake detection API end to end, from authoring the PRD to packaging detection for financial crimes, KYC, and identity fraud use cases. Authored 50-page technical responses to federal RFIs covering synthetic identity detection, biometric liveness, and AI-enabled fraud threat modeling.

work.name: Veriff
work.summary: Global identity verification platform. Enterprise procurement cycles with General Counsels, CISOs, and Heads of Fraud at financial institutions. Deep expertise in KYC and AML-adjacent identity verification workflows in regulated industries.

work.name: Root Connection
work.summary: Founded and ran a scientific research and horticultural design firm, growing it to $1MM in annual revenue.
